text:
emma: FYI: new user hit a LoadError when following the Ruby quickstart in the README.

emma: The README currently shows: 
```ruby
# README quickstart
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(input: 'hello')
puts resp.output
```

emma: But the published gem is `redwood-inference` and the public class is `RedwoodClient` now. Copy/paste leads to `cannot load such file -- redwood` or `uninitialized constant Redwood`.

noah: Ah yep. We renamed the package during the 2.x rollout and docs didn't get updated. Also the sample app in /samples/ruby still pins the old gem in Gemfile.lock so folks installing the sample hit the same mismatch.

sam: Proposed fix: update README to show the current package and constructor, e.g.:
```ruby
# corrected README snippet
require 'redwood-inference'
client = RedwoodClient.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(input: 'hello')
puts resp['output']
```

sam: And update samples/ruby/Gemfile to use `gem 'redwood-inference', '~> 2.0'`. Also add a short note: "If you get LoadError, run `bundle install` and ensure Gemfile uses `redwood-inference`."

emma: Can we also add a tiny CI smoke job for Ruby? Run the quickstart on matrix: ruby-version [2.7, 3.0, 3.1] to catch these package-name drifts early.

ci-bot: Draft job created: docs/snippet-smoke-ruby -> strategy.matrix.ruby: [2.7,3.0,3.1]. Proposal queued.

noah: I'll open a docs PR to update the README and a samples PR to change the Gemfile and add a smoke test.

docs-bot: Created DOCS-623: "Ruby quickstart: update gem name and constructor; add Gemfile sync and Ruby snippet smoke tests". Linked drafts: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/221 (drafts).

emma: Nice. Also nit: the README still shows ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'] but our Console onboarding email gives a PowerShell one-liner using $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY. Maybe add a brief platform note (Bash vs PowerShell) to avoid confusion.

sam: Good call. I'll include a one-line note in the PR: "Use ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'] in Ruby; see Windows PowerShell example in Troubleshooting."

noah: Will ping for reviews once PRs are up. This should stop a lot of early friction. :thumbsup:
